Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:11:1.hebrew: ידעתי - אהבתי, כמו (תהילים א׳:ו׳) יודע ה' דרך צדיקים, וכמו (שמות לג) ואדעך בשם:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:11:1.english: I have known - I have loved [you], like (Psalms 1:6): "The Lord knows the way of the righteous," and like (Exodus 33): "And I have known you by name."

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:11:3.hebrew: ברחמיה מסיק ליה - מעלהו על אוהבו. והנם זועפים (בראשית מ׳:ו׳) מתרגמינן נסיסין. לשון אחר: סוסיא, סוס שעסקו רע, את אוהבו מעלין עליו כדי שימות:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:11:3.english: He brings it up upon his beloved - He brings it up upon his beloved. And "and behold, they were distraught" (Genesis 40:6) we translate as nesisin. Another explanation: Susya [means] a horse whose behavior is bad; they mount his beloved upon it so that he will die.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:14:1.hebrew: נפרע ממנו מעט מעט - כן ישראל, נפרע מהן הקב"ה את כל עונותיהן בעוה"ז, כדי שיזכו ליום הדין, ועובדי כוכבים אינו נפרע מהן כלל, כדי לטרדן מן העוה"ב. ופקידה משמע מעט מעט, כאדם שפוקד את חבירו לפרקים:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:14:1.english: He collects from him little by little - So too [with] Israel: the Holy One, Blessed be He, collects from them [for] all their iniquities in this world, so that they will be acquitted on the Day of Judgment; and [as for] idolaters, He does not collect from them at all, in order to banish them from the World to Come. And *pekidah* [visitation] implies little by little, like a person who visits his friend from time to time.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:17:1.hebrew: ממקדשי תחלו - גבי ארבעה משחיתים שבאו להשחית את ירושלים, כתיב ביחזקאל:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:17:1.english: Begin at My Sanctuary - Regarding the four destroyers who came to destroy Jerusalem, it is written in Ezekiel.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:18:1.hebrew: זועם בכל יום - ואפילו הכי קיימין, וכתיב מי יעמוד:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:18:1.english: [God] is indignant every day - And even so they endure, and it is written: "Who can stand?"

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:18:2.english: In [the case of] an individual - [The verse states:] "Who can stand?"

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:18:3.hebrew: בצבור - אף על גב דבכל יום זועם, מתקיימין:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:18:3.english: In [the case of] a community - Even though He is indignant every day, they endure.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:1:1.hebrew: היום הבא - השמש הבאה, דבכמה דוכתין קרינן לשמשא יומא:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:1:1.english: The coming day - The coming sun, for in several places we call the sun "day".

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:2:1.hebrew: ויצאתם ופשתם - סיפא דוזרחה לכם הוא. ופשתם לשון שומן וריבוי ועובי, כמו (תרגום בראשית א) פושו וסגו, וכמו (איוב ל״ה:ט״ו) ולא ידע בפש מאד:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:2:1.english: And you shall go forth and grow fat - This is the end of [the verse,] "And [the sun] shall arise for you." And *ufashtem* is an expression of fatness, increase, and thickness, like (Targum Genesis 1): "Increase and multiply," and like (Job 35:15): "And He does not regard abundance exceedingly."

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:4:1.hebrew: לא מצאנוהו שיהא שגיא כח בעת הדין - אם ישגיא כחו, יתחייבו כולם כלייה:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:4:1.english: We have not found Him to be great in power at the time of judgment - If He were to magnify His power, all would be condemned to destruction.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:1.hebrew: ר' אחא בר חנינא אמר תרוייהו בישראל - וה"ק: אע"פ שבעל חימה אני, חימה אין לי, כבר נשבעתי מקצוף עליך:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:1.english: Rabbi Aḥa bar Ḥanina says: Both of them are with regard to the Jewish people - And this is what it means: Even though I am a possessor of fury, fury is not in Me, [for] I have already sworn [not] to be angry with you.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:2.english: Would that I - It is the latter part of this verse.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:3.hebrew: שמיר ושית - לשון ארץ גזירה וחורבן, ודוגמתו (איכה ג) השאת והשבר:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:3.english: Briers and thorns - [This is] an expression of a desolate land and destruction, and an example of it is (Lamentations 3): "The desolation and the destruction."

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:1.hebrew: והיינו דרבי אלכסנדרי - אדלעיל קאי, דאין הקב"ה בא בטרוניא עם בריותיו:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:1.english: And this is [what] Rabbi Alexandri [said] - It refers to that which is stated above, that the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not deal tyrannically with His creatures.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:2.english: In their records - In the book of remembrance of their deeds.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:3.hebrew: ואם לאו אשמידם - ובדין אפקוד עליהם, ולא בחמלה, כי אם בדקדוק, כדאמרינן לעיל: מקדיר עליהם חמה מנרתקה, אולי יבעטו:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:3.english: And if not, I will destroy them - And with [strict] justice I will visit [punishment] upon them, and not with compassion, but rather with exactitude, as we said above: He makes the sun beat down upon them from its sheath, [to see] perhaps they will kick [at it].

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:7:1.english: And this is also that which Rava said - That the Holy One, Blessed be He, judges idolaters with exactitude.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:7:2.hebrew: עוה עוה עוה אשימנה - עיווי עיותה, ולעוה אשימנה. וכן תרגום יונתן: חוביהון חבו, בחוביהון אתפרע מינהון:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:7:2.english: A ruin, a ruin, a ruin, will I make it - A distortion of its distortion, and into a ruin I will make it. And similarly, Targum Yonatan [translates]: "Their sins they sinned; for their sins I will exact retribution from them."

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:7:3.hebrew: כפיד - ניקור, ביקדור"א בלע"ז, שמנקרין מעט מעט. וכן נפרע מהן מעט מעט, בהסתר פנים, בוהיה לאכול, לפדותם מעונותיהן, כדי שיזכו לעוה"ב:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:7:3.english: Like the pecking - Pecking, bechedure in Old French, for they peck little by little. And likewise, He exacts retribution from them little by little, through the hiding of [His] face [and] through "and it shall be devoured," to redeem them from their iniquities, in order that they may merit the World to Come.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:8:1.hebrew: להם שוע - אני נותן להם פדיון, כמו (שמות יד) ויושע ופרק, וכמו (ב"ק דף פ.) ישוע הבן, פדיון:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:8:1.english: To them is salvation - I give them redemption, as in (Exodus 14): "And [the Lord] saved," [which the Targum translates as] "and He redeemed"; and as in (Bava Kamma 80a): "the salvation of the son," [which means] redemption.

Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:9:1.hebrew: והיינו דא"ר אבא - אפדם לישראל בממונם, והיינו כפיד של תרנגולין, פורעין מעט מעט, ונוגשיך בצדקה:
Rashi on Avodah Zarah 4a:9:1.english: And this is what Rabbi Abba said - [God said,] "I will redeem Israel through their money" — and this is [like] "the pecking of hens": they exact payment little by little, and [as it is written,] "and your exactors [shall be] righteousness."

Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:17:1.hebrew: שהיה בידם למחות - והא דאמרי' בסוף חזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף ס:), מוטב שיהיו שוגגין ואל יהיו מזידין — היינו בדבר שידוע שלא יקבלו אם ימחו:
Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:17:1.english: That they had the power to protest - And that which we say at the end of [the chapter] Chezkas HaBattim (Bava Batra 60b), "It is better that they be unwitting [sinners] and not be intentional [sinners]" — that applies to a matter where it is known that they will not accept [the rebuke] if they protest.

Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:1.hebrew: חימה אין לי שכבר נשבעתי - ואין להקשות מפרק ד' נדרים (נדרים לב.), דמוכח דמשה הרגו לחימה; דאיכא לשנויי: תרי חימה הוו, כדמשני נמי התם:
Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:5:1.english: Fury is not in Me, as I have already sworn - And one should not raise a difficulty from the fourth chapter of Nedarim (Nedarim 32a), which proves that Moses killed Ḥeima [the angel of wrath], for it can be answered: There were two [angels named] Ḥeima, as [the Gemara] also answers there.

Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:1.hebrew: והיינו דר' אלכסנדרי - פ"ה דקאי אההיא דקאמרינן לעיל, דאין הקדוש ברוך הוא בא בטרוניא עם בריותיו. ולא נהירא פירושו, דהא איפסיק ליה טובא. ונראה לר"ת דקאי אהא דסליק: כאן בישראל, כאן בעובדי כוכבים, וקאמרינן דבעל חימה קאי אעובדי כוכבים. והיינו דרבי אלכסנדרי, דקאמר: ביום ההוא אבקש, שאם לא ימצא להם זכות ישמידם; והיינו נמי דרבא, דאמר שיש חילוק בין ישראל לעובדי כוכבים:
Tosafot on Avodah Zarah 4a:6:1.english: And this is that of Rabbi Alexandri - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained that it refers to that which we said above: that the Holy One, Blessed be He, does not deal tyrannically with His creatures. However, his explanation does not appear correct, for they are separated by a great deal [of intervening text]. And it appears to Rabbeinu Tam that it refers to that which immediately preceded: "Here regarding Israel, here regarding idolaters" — and we said that "Master of fury" refers to idolaters. And this is that of Rabbi Alexandri, who said: "On that day I will seek" — that if He does not find any merit for them, He will destroy them; and this is also that of Rava, who said that there is a distinction between Israel and idolaters.
